sourceSentences: [0] She has very annoying spells because of her W blocking the damage, reflecting projectiles, and also giving her shield.
[0] You can bait out her Q. We saw Faker do it here in this specific example when he walks to to the lane here.

[0] You got to keep in mind that Mel wants to use her Q onto your last hit, which is going to put her in a position where she can have an easier time landing the spell because the spell has a pretty big delay.
[0] Baiting out her W can be a very effective tool for you to get control of the lane because the cool down is so incredibly long.
[0] He baited out the Mel W by throwing the charm besides the Mel, which incentivizes Mel to use her W and then you of course you get your spell back before Mel does

[1] fun fact! you can dodge her q! and you can bait her shield by throwing your w at her and making it look like youre about to go in! and then you just dont go in. then her cd is wasted and THEN you go in. easy as that!

[2] So, it doesn't make you immune now when you reflect. It like gives you a shield, but it still reflects projectiles.
